info.title: Survicate Universal API
info.description: Access Survicate Data Export API surveys, responses, respondents, and personal-data endpoints from MindCloud.

delete.description: Deletes personal data by email from Survicate.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address for which to delete all associated data.

schema.description: The email address for which to delete all associated data.

message.description: Confirmation message about the deletion result.

deleted_insights_hub.description: Number of deleted Insights Hub records.

deleted_respondents.description: Number of deleted Survicate respondent-related records.

total_deleted.description: Total number of deleted records across services.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves personal data counts by email from Survicate.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address to search for across all data sources.

schema.description: The email address to search for across all data sources.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

authorAttributes.description: Number of Insights Hub author attribute records.

authors.description: Number of Insights Hub author records.

notes.description: Number of Insights Hub note records.

notesAttributes.description: Number of Insights Hub note attribute records.

total.description: Total number of Insights Hub records.

respondents.description: Total number of respondent records associated with the email address.

responses.description: Total number of survey responses associated with the email address.
